sections.title: Service of notice in case of discontinued business.
sections.text_before_clauses: Where an assessment is to be made under section 320, the Assessing Officer may serve on the—

clauses.text: person whose income is to be assessed; or
person who was a member of a firm or association of persons at the time of its discontinuance, in the case of a firm or an association of persons; or
principal officer, in the case of a company,

sections.text_after_clauses: a notice containing all or any of the requirements which may be included in a notice under section 268(1) and the provisions of this Act shall, so far as may be, apply accordingly as if the notice were a notice issued under that section.
